title: Rethinking Oscar's architecture: extensibility, modularity, and a path forward
author: joeyjurjens
body_preview: This builds on discussions from #2972 (2019) about splitting Oscar into core/storefront/dashboard and extracting business logic from views. Those ideas were never fully realized. This issue goes further and proposes rethinking Oscar's fundamental extensibility model.
